import re

with open('src/humanize/number.py', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Update intword
content = re.sub(
    r'^def intword\(value, format="%.1f"\):',
    'def intword(value: object, format: str = "%.1f") -> str:',
    content,
    flags=re.MULTILINE
)

# Update apnumber
content = re.sub(
    r'^def apnumber\(value\):',
    'def apnumber(value: int) -> str:',
    content,
    flags=re.MULTILINE
)

# Update fractional
content = re.sub(
    r'^def fractional\(value\):',
    'def fractional(value: object) -> str:',
    content,
    flags=re.MULTILINE
)

# Update scientific
content = re.sub(
    r'^def scientific\(value, precision=2\):',
    'def scientific(value: float, precision: int = 2) -> str:',
    content,
    flags=re.MULTILINE
)

# Update clamp
content = re.sub(
    r'^def clamp\(value, format="\{:}", floor=None, ceil=None, floor_token="<", ceil_token=">"\):',
    'def clamp(\n    value: float | None,\n    format: str | callable = "{:}",\n    floor: float | None = None,\n    ceil: float | None = None,\n    floor_token: str = "<",\n    ceil_token: str = ">",\n) -> str:',
    content,
    flags=re.MULTILINE
)

with open('src/humanize/number.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

print("Updated number.py")
EOF
